entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. My name is Alex. How can I assist you today?
Yeah, hi. I want to return something. I bought a VeloBand Pulse a little over two weeks ago, and it's just not working out for me.
I understand. I can definitely help you with a return. Could you please provide your order number or the email address associated with the purchase of your VeloBand Pulse?
It's [customer's email address]. And hurry it up, I don't have all day.
Thank you. One moment while I pull up your order… Okay, I see your purchase of the VeloBand Pulse on [date]. You’re calling about returning that?
Yes! That's right. It's not accurate. The heart rate readings are all over the place. It’s supposed to be a smart watch, but it's acting dumb.

I'm sorry to hear that you're experiencing issues with the accuracy of your VeloBand Pulse. Our return policy typically allows for returns within 90 days of purchase. Since you purchased it on [date], you're well within that window.
90 days? Really? I thought I read somewhere it was shorter than that. Well, great! So, what do I need to do?

To initiate the return, I will email you a prepaid shipping label. Simply repackage the VeloBand Pulse in its original packaging, attach the label, and drop it off at your nearest [shipping carrier] location. Once we receive the returned item, we'll process a full refund to your original method of payment.
Okay, that sounds easy enough. When can I expect the label?
The email with the shipping label should arrive in your inbox within the next few minutes. Please also check your spam folder just in case. Was there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, I think that's everything. Thanks for the help. I appreciate it.
You're very welcome! We apologize for the inconvenience you experienced with the VeloBand Pulse. Have a great day!
